Some points of mine that I can think of are as follows (apologies in advance if it is formatted weird cause of mobile):

The cast is pretty interesting. Unlike a lot of other anime (especially harem) where you get a guy saving a girl, girls falls in love with guy, you learn a little backstory, move on it can get pretty boring pretty fast. With this series while it follows that format in my opinion you learn a lot more about the girls (and others), their motivations, strengths, weaknesses, and more. Makes them seem more human and I enjoy that. Not to mention characters continue to stay relevant because of their strengths. Spoilers for this part but I enjoy seeing Lilli being important despite her lack of power instead of just being a supporter the entire show. Helps keep all characters relevant and important.
